applicabilityBasis.summary: Spark USDC Vault is a variable-exchange-rate ERC-4626 investment receipt. Interest, fees and investment results affect the assets redeemable per share; the share has no documented issuer obligation to redeem for a fixed amount of monetary value.

genius.notes: Reviewed 2026-10-07 as the exact Base Spark USDC Vault holder receipt (0x7bfa7c4f149e7415b73bdedfe609237e29cbf34a), distinct from Spark Savings spUSDC and from direct parent USDC holdings. The native ERC-4626 share redeems at a variable asset exchange rate subject to strategy liquidity and investment results. GENIUS section 2(22) fixed monetary-value issuer obligation is not established for this yield receipt, so payment-stablecoin authorization, issuer pathway, foreign exception and DASP payment-stablecoin restriction are not applicable. No parent token authorization or issuerEntity is inherited. MiCA scope is independently assessed as outside this tracker EMT/ART model.
